media: 45 bundled photographs; all content imagery is photographic (0 drawn media). Exact photos only of their own subject (المسجد الحرام، متحف برج الساعة، جبل النور، and the landmarks of محيط الحرم and أجياد); verified Makkah photos as context (13 neighbourhoods, city-level content); generic photos of non-place subjects; tiers, credits and licences are recorded in PHOTO_SOURCES.md, not shown or explained in the app; no imagery of other cities (see PHOTO_SOURCES.md, docs/MEDIA_AUDIT.md, docs/APP_QUALITY_AUDIT.md)
offers: 59 offer records (57 running) on one shared model, attached only to Rihab Makkah's own listings — never to a real place; shown on cards, decision pages, Home/Discover deal rails, My Plan and the Assistant; prepared content, not live commercial offers
assistant: Free-text Rihab Makkah Assistant over the four-part Intent Bank (153 intents, 2,159 AR/EN examples) — deterministic, on-device, no LLM or external API
entry: Rihab entry: one Rihab sign-in (or a new Rihab account) at the site root, then the city picker; this app opens signed in. A city has no sign-in screens of its own. The first visit to a city asks for its own profile (resident or visitor, chosen once per city), prefilled from the account
accounts: One Rihab account for both cities, on the device (hashed passwords; rihab.accounts.v1). Each city keeps its own profile, plan, communities and requests for the account
starter_plan: New accounts start with «خطة مقترحة لك» / Recommended for you: 3–4 planned items from the inventory, chosen per persona (resident: participation, food, own interest, getting out; visitor: an editorial must-do, food, two interests), using interests, area and language; real places are preferred where they fit
real_places: 178 real Makkah places (165 venues added 4 Oct 2026: 91 food, 27 cafés, 23 shopping, 11 parks, 5 walkways/sports, culture and heritage sites), each in the district its public sources give, with sources and confidence kept in the data and docs (never shown in the app); no hours, prices, ratings or offers stated; visuals: 66 place photos (60 supplied photographs reused across a brand's branches, plus 2 library photos), 67 brand logos (39 supplied, 3 Simple Icons marks), 1 context photo, 44 drawn category tiles; no stock imagery, and no tier is labelled or explained in the app — see docs/REAL_PLACES.md
experiences: One app, two experiences chosen once at profile setup and never changeable: resident (ساكن في مكة — local life, palm-green theme) and visitor (زائر — trip companion, brass theme, no neighbourhood required). Same five tabs and one shared Save/Plan/Join/hand-off/Community/Assistant system — see docs/DUAL_EXPERIENCE.md
demo_accounts: Two Rihab demo accounts, a resident and a visitor in both cities, normal on-device accounts present on every launch; sign-in details are in the Rihab repository's README, not published with the app
makkah_opportunities: «فرص مكة» on Home: Live in Makkah (7 homes to rent, own or stay in longer) and Invest in Makkah (7 business opportunities); register interest or request details, tracked in «طلباتي» / My requests on the device — see docs/CITY_OPPORTUNITIES.md
platform: Part of Rihab (رحاب): one entry for Rihab Makkah and Rihab Madinah, served under /makkah/
market: «السوق» / Market tab: experiences and services from the shared inventory (booked or requested from their own pages) and 10 Makkah products (dates, gifts, crafts, perfumes) with indicative prices and a request sheet
requests: «طلباتي» / My requests: product and service requests, home details requests and registered interest, kept per account on the device only and never sent to any seller, provider or organisation; no payments
